text:
Harper: Quick morale boost — meet my foster piglet, Marshmallow 🐷✨. He refuses socks but loves couch pirouettes. Pics attached below.
Noah: i cannot handle this level of fluff. audible 'awww' 😭
Aisha: that curl of the tail. need to adopt immediately. what age is he?
Harper: ~6 weeks! tiny nails, big personality. rescue said low-key champ around people.
Tom: tiny sweater or pirate hat? cause those are the only two options that make sense.
Riley: name poll: react to the root with :one: Marshmallow / :two: Mallow / :three: Poppy / :four: Mr. Squeaks
Aisha: voted :one: — also can we get a tiny cape? for dramatic exits.
Harper: adding pics: https://imgur.com/Rmsh1 (sprawled on couch), https://imgur.com/Rmsh2 (attempted pirouette)
Noah: Giphy: *posts GIF 'piglet zoomies'*
Tom: harper, if i volunteer to pet-sit, do i have to sign an NDA for excessive cuteness?
Harper: only non-disclosure: promise not to film him with my slippers.
Tom: deal. :ok_hand:
Riley: can we add one of these to the team's monday wallpaper rotation? would make mornings better.
Harper: yep — full-res on the team drive: drive.redwood.ai/pets/marshmallow (internal link). feel free to use 1 or 2.
Aisha: also tagging people who asked about fostering resources earlier: @Noah @Tom — rescue was Little Hooves Network.
Noah: bookmarking, thanks! :heart_eyes:
Harper: thanks y'all. marshmallow sends snout boops.
